import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    n = int(n)
    
    best = 1e18
    best_a = 1
    best_b = 1
    base = x / y
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        approx = int(math.floor(base * i + 0.5))
        cur = abs(approx / i - base)
        
        if cur < best:
            best = cur
            best_a = approx
            best_b = i
    
    print(f"{best_a}/{best_b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
